primary_statistical_verdict.hypothesis: On matched deterministic failures, structured-feedback targeted repair increases hidden-gold recovery by at least 10 percentage points over equal-budget raw-feedback full regeneration, exceeds the preregistered 34.31% third-blind-retry break-even, and does not increase catastrophic failures by 2 percentage points or more.
